findings.title: Partial settings state is not rolled back on load failure
findings.message: On a settings load error, LoadAllSettings may already have applied partial defaults, including DisableWindowGeometrySaver, and nothing rolls them back. The caller then calls fail, which uses os.Exit. The process exits, so this is tolerable there. The helper is reusable, though, and leaves global state mutated on error. The test only asserts this behavior without guarding against it.
findings.suggestion: Snapshot DisableWindowGeometrySaver before LoadAllSettings and restore it on error, or document that the helper is fatal-only.
